reviews.t: Boulangerie délicieuse, le pain les viennoiseries et les sandwichs sont vraiment un plaisir à chaque fois. Et l’accueil est toujours très agréable. Prête à faire un détour pour aller là bas à chaque fois.
Eine der besten Bäckereien hier. Unglaublich gute Croissants und pain au chocolat

Je cherchais une boulangerie entre mon hôtel et la gare du Nord, sur le trajet, je suis tombée sur ici. Et bien c'est une super adresse ! J'ai pris 2 pains au chocolat qui furent excellents ! Chocolat fondant, bon goût de beurre et à un prix correct pour la capitale !
Et que dire de l'accueil du patron... Sourire et bonne humeur !
Peut-être l’une des meilleures traditions de Paris et probablement les meilleurs croissants et pains au chocolat. Servis toujours avec le sourire !

I was staying just down the street for a few days but even if I hadn’t been, I would have gone out of my way to go here again. I picked up a pain au chocolat and another treat every morning while I was on vacation. Every day, despite my broken French, I was greeted warmly and with kindness. And the taste and textures of everything I had has me longing for anything comparable back home. Truly, one of the highlights of my vacation and I can’t recommend it enough.

Abbiamo fatto colazione tutti i giorni con i croissant, pain au chocolat, pain raisin di questa fantastica boulangerie. Trovata il primo giorno, siamo voluti tornare sempre qua. Loro sono gentilissimi e i loro prodotti sono eccezionali a prezzi ottimi. Ci tornerei altre mille volte, consigliatissima

Vraiment top d top.
Une baguette tradition magnifique !!!!!
Large choix de produits !!!
Tout est frais !!!!!!
La quiche Lorraine un délice!!!!!
Le frian au fromage magnifique !!!!!
Les croissants et les pains au chocolat une tuerie !!!!!
En plus le patron magnifique qui a des problèmes de ouï Vraiment  Vraiment exceptionnel. !!!!
Toujours avec le sourire. !!!!!
Ça fait vraiment plaisir.
Merci beaucoup monsieur.!!!!
Le personnel est super sympa aussi !!!!
Toujours al écoute et des propositions sur les choix.

Merci encore pour la qualité.

Bravo !!!!!
La meilleure baguette de Paris ! Le pain au chocolat est délicieux et les personnes qui travaillent dans cette boulangerie sont adorables ! Je recommande vivement.
The best croissant and pain au chocolates we’ve tried so far in Paris, and we’ve tried a lot!
De los mejores pain au chocolat de París. Muy simpáticos.

This little shop has the best pastries I've ever had. I make a point of coming back every time I visit Paris just so I can stuff my face with delicious croissants and pains au chocolat. If you're anywhere in the area (or live 5,000 miles away like I do), it's worth making the trip.

Possibly the best boulangerie I’ve ever been to in Paris. Of course there’s hundreds if not thousands, so surely many are very good; however, this one is run by the cutest old couple who are so friendly and cute and the pain au chocolat was absolutely incredible. Clearly a place where care and craft are given to every creation. I’d go back in a heartbeat next time I’m in Paris.

진짜 … 맨날와서 먹고싶은 맛
주인 아저씨도 친절하심
💚Pain au chocolates 진짜 페이스트리 바삭함 미쳤음 …. 심지어 아침에 비와서 습도도 높았지만 여전히 미친 바삭함 … 다른 큰 체인점 보다 여기가 찐입니다 …! ㅠ 내일도 또 가야지 … 가격도 개 착함 …
💚 pain au raisin 커스타드가 부드러운에 페이스트리는 바삭함 …! 건포도의 새콤달콤함이 커스타드와 잘 어우러짐
💚croissant 말해뭐해 … 바사삭 바사삭 …. 존맛이다 …!
개인적으로 파리에서 최고의 베이커리 맛집이 아닐까 ? 재방문의사 💯

Superb products and very friendly service. We tried the pain aux amandes  and pain au chocolat and both were divine. Then the cheesy bread with olives were amazing. Sadly for us, we discovered this amazing small boulangerie only our our very last day in Paris. Totally recommended  for fresh, delicious and reasonably priced baked goods.
Lovely little bakery with some of the best pain au chocolats! Go there!

Best pain au chocolate that I had in Paris and exactly what I was looking for! Just as good as des pain et idees which has a zillion person line. More local and laid back. Absolutely recommend!! Wish I had taken a photo but I was too enthralled with eating

A wonderful find nearby our rental.
Visually beautiful pastries that are super yummy.
From the pain chocolat and the various baguette sandwiches, you cannot go wrong. Prices were more than reasonable and fair.
We visited daily during our stay and would continue to visit if our trip didn’t come to an end.
A wonderful place for your sweet tooth.

découvert (grève oblige) cette boulangerie ce matin et les viennoiseries sont excellentes rarement dégusté d aussi bonnes !
De plus le personnel est souriant et accueillant. BRAVO
i was so lucky to be near this gem! pastries were lovely and staff were so lovely. ended up going every day during my stay in paris. highly recommend the almond pain au chocolat and coffee eclair
Très bonnes viennoiseries.

L’une des meilleures, voire LA meilleure boulangerie pâtisserie du coin !
Produits frais, prix intéressants, très bons gâteaux et viennoiseries, et surtout… les propriétaires sont adorables !
Vous l’aurez compris, je recommande vivement 😄
I went 8:30am in the morning. Fresh croissant and pain au chocolat. Very friendly man and lady. Feel local and welcoming. Unpretentious but great baked goods.
The line was out the door when we ventured into this neighbors spot. Picked up a few pain au chocolates. They were pretty good, not the best I've had in this neighborhood, but definitely up there!
Accueil très agréable et très jolie boutique. En revanche, par rapport à la notation, les viennoiseries étaient bonnes mais rien de particulier (un peu molles). On reviendra tester les pâtisseries :)
I went to try their pain au chocolat unfortunately left little to be desired. It tasted slightly stale, I didn’t end up finishing it
